rejection_summary: The Mysterious Wall (1967/1968, tt0164187): scientists and a research station actively investigate a periodic electrostatic dome and attempt communication, but the phenomenon ultimately remains unresolved; the film shifts toward dreamlike personal visions and symbolic ambiguity rather than enough concrete rule discovery/payoff to clear the 82 baseline threshold.

X the Unknown (1956, tt0049967): strong scientist-led investigation identifies a radiation-feeding subterranean entity and develops/tests a neutralization method, but the latter structure becomes a creature-threat containment/destruction story and lacks enough broader high-concept escalation to clear 82.

Time Loop (2019/2020, tt8458534): father-and-son time-travel experiments create escalating temporal consequences, but available whole-runtime evidence indicates a confusing, poorly developed loop structure with insufficient sustained scientific investigation and rule discovery to clear 82.
